text:
بہت پتریں کل میہنا؛
بہت میہیں کن گھٹ۔
romanized:
Bahut puttri kul méhna;
Bahut mihi kan ghatt.
literal_en:
From many sons comes reproach on a family,
From excessive rains the outturn becomes small.
meaning_en: as some of them are sure to get into trouble.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
